title: Software Engineer - Fullstack (React + Java/Python/.Net)
description:
**About Gartner IT :**
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About this role:**
Software Development position responsible for design, implementation, and support of applications to help fulfill our Research & Consulting Delivery strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Do :**

* Designing, implementing, unit, integration testing and supporting Web based applications and services
* Contribute to the review and analysis of business requirements
* Collaborate on architecture and technical design discussions
* Perform and participate in code reviews, peer inspections and technical design/specifications
* Documenting and review detailed design
* Be able to work in teams and collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements
* Be able to innovate and showcase new approaches to improve efficiency
* Be able to work in a globally distributed team in an Agile/Scrum approach

**What you’ll need:**
Graduate or Postgraduate in technology from a reputed Institute having 2-4 years of experience in the software development field
  
  
**Must Have**

* 2-4 years Full stack development experience of using ReactJS with either Python/Java/.Net.
* Experience working on Relational databases (MySQL/Postgres/SQLMI) including intermediate exposure in writing SQL queries.
* Experience in utilizing & deploying Azure services (App Service, Blob, Azure AI Services, etc.,)
* Exposure to AI Assisted development practices would be a plus

**Who you are:**

* Effective time management skills and ability to meet deadlines
* Excellent communications skills interacting with technical and business audience’s
* Excellent organization, multitasking, and prioritization skills
* Must possess a willingness and aptitude to acquire business acumen, embrace new technologies/ideas & master concepts rapidly
* Intellectual curiosity, passion for technology and keeping up with new trends
* Delivering project work on-time within budget with high quality

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Java Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using modern Java-based technologies in an agile environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* Participate in requirements analysis, technical design, and architecture discussions.
* Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Perform unit, integration, and automated testing following TDD/BDD practices.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Work with DevOps and support teams to monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, build, release, and deployment processes.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team skill development.
* Collaborate effectively within distributed agile scrum teams.

**Technical Skills & Experience**

* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience with microservices, service-oriented architecture, and RESTful web services.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) including Lambda, ECS, S3, SNS, Kinesis, and CloudWatch.
* Experience with containerization using Docker.
* Proficiency in relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Snowflake.
* Familiarity with API tools such as Swagger and Postman.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycle and agile methodologies.
* Experience with GitHub, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and modern AI-assisted development tools.

**Quality & Testing**

* Strong commitment to code quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing, unit testing, and integration testing.
* Knowledge of application performance monitoring and troubleshooting.

**Soft Skills & Collaboration**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage timelines, highlight risks, and provide regular status updates.
* Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–6+ years of professional software development experience, primarily in Java-based systems.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Full Stack
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
  
  
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
  
  
Greenlight is looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused for our Web Core team. This team focuses on core web initiatives including bringing the core Greenlight functionality on the web for the first time and functioning as a horizontal platform team to support other web teams. This includes setting standards, defining best practices, building common libraries and mentoring other web developers. You will be expected to also make contributions to our backend services as required to accomplish the team deliverables.
  
  
This role reports to a Senior Director, Engineering
  
  
**Technologies we use:**

* Node.js
* React, NextJS, Remix
* REST,Express
* AWS, Kubernetes (EKS)
* Kotlin experience preferred

**Your day-to-day:**

* Product development - Building new experiences for the Greenlight website. Work with domain teams, product managers and designers to bring different parts of the Greenlight mobile application experience to web
* Platform - As part of the web core team, you will have to support all web development within Greenlight. This includes providing mentorship and support for web teams, defining standards, best practices and determining technologies
* Working in a strong team to quickly deliver on our web products.
* Work with product and design teams to continuously add incremental features while balancing new features and tech debt
* Scaling and maintaining our backend services to evolve with new feature requests and support our growing user base
* Improving the reliability and availability of the platform which supports our families and partners

**What you’ll bring to the team:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* 6+ years software development experience
* The ability to context switch frequently in a fast-paced environment
* An eye towards performance, scalability, and observability
* Experience building single page applications using a modern framework
* Experience building REST apis
* Recent experience building backend services using node.js
* Understanding of how to execute well on the build/measure/learn process and lean startup skills

**Preferred experience:**

* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation
* Experience working with modern MarTech tools such as Segment, Optimizely, Mixpanel, etc

**Who we are:**
It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Software Engineer (Platform/EOS/Networking)
description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With**
You will work with the Platform team who work closest to the hardware and programming chips.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a
**Software Engineer**
your core responsibility is to deliver new cutting edge product features. A major part of this is writing and owning design/implementation of the code that drives our products. However, the role of a Software Engineer is much bigger than ‘simply’ writing code. Software engineers work on the whole development process, including:
  
  

* Suggesting and deciding what features to build
* Driving the design and architecture
* Pushing, testing, documenting the feature
* Working alongside customers in the field if needed

**Are you right for this role**
?
  
  
This Is An Interesting And Exciting Opportunity To Be a Part Of The Software Development Team That Is Redefining Data Center Switching. For Success At Arista All You Need Is
  
  

* Strong industry experience of 5+ years
* Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills
* Fluency in C/C++ programming
* Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

**Qualifications**

* Strong software debugging skills especially in embedded systems.
* Experience with software development for the forwarding ASICs, FPGAs, Network Processors etc
* Experience with hardware abstraction layer

**About the Role:**
Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to and own the quality of what ships.
  
  
EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users.
  
  
The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists:**

* Takes AI ideas from problem framing to working software at a days-to-weeks cadence, building with digital workers and owning the quality of what ships.

* Raises the team's standards through code review, documentation and reusable components that others adopt without rework.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Delivery & Experimentation:**

* Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision.

**Agent-Operated Engineering:**

* Build with digital workers as the default mode of engineering: direct them, validate what they generate and course-correct at engineering speed. Review, test and approve their work within the remit EAI's operating model sets, and escalate what falls outside it.

**Platforms & APIs:**

:

* Build evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring for your features, including output quality signals, model drift and guardrail compliance.

\\
  
  
**Standards & Reusable Components:**

* Build reusable components, SDKs, agents, prompt templates and reference architectures adopted by engineers outside your own pod, and drive consolidation where you find duplication.

* A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler.

description:
**About The Role And Team**
Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a
**Senior Staff Software Engineer in Rider**
, you will shape the technical architecture and long-term evolution of the systems that power the Rider experience globally.
  
  
Deep mobile architecture expertise will be the anchor for this role, but not its boundary. You will operate across mobile clients, edge capabilities, and backend services, tackling problems spanning application architecture, performance, reliability, server-driven experiences, client-server contracts, and emerging on-device intelligence.
  
  
Your impact will extend well beyond the code you write. You will shape how multiple engineering teams build and ship Rider experiences—establishing durable technical foundations, simplifying complex systems, making high-leverage architectural decisions, and enabling teams to move faster without compromising performance, reliability, or quality.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define the multi-year technical strategy and architecture for Rider experiences across mobile applications, client platforms, edge capabilities, and supporting backend services.
* Set the architectural direction for the Rider application and client platform, enabling multiple teams to independently build and evolve experiences without compromising performance, reliability, or consistency.
* Establish engineering standards and technical foundations across architecture, dependency management, build health, application size, startup and runtime performance, observability, testing, and release quality.
* Architect server-driven and cross-platform experience frameworks, making deliberate trade-offs between native, web-based, shared, and backend-driven implementations.

description:
**Company:**

Fegmo

**Experience:**

3–6 years

**Role:**

AI Engineer

**Focus Areas:**

Agentic AI, LLMs, Agent Orchestration, Tool Calling, Knowledge Graphs, System Design

**About Fegmo**

Fegmo is building AI-powered solutions for the next generation of commerce. Our platform leverages AI agents to automate product data enrichment, catalog intelligence, content generation, product information management, and commerce workflows.

We are developing an agentic commerce platform where intelligent agents interact with enterprise systems, invoke tools, reason over product data, and use knowledge graphs to deliver accurate, contextual, and actionable outcomes.

We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals, practical Generative AI experience, and a solid understanding of system design. You will work on building and orchestrating AI agents, developing reusable tools and services, and integrating knowledge graphs into intelligent commerce workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agentic AI & Orchestration**

• Design, develop, and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step commerce workflows.

• Build agent workflows involving planning, tool selection, execution, validation, and result synthesis.

• Develop reusable agent capabilities and tools that can be composed into larger workflows.

• Implement state management, context handling, task delegation, and coordination between agents where appropriate.

• Build reliable orchestration mechanisms with retries, timeouts, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

• Evaluate when to use autonomous agents versus deterministic workflows to ensure reliability and control.

**2. Generative AI & LLM Engineering**

• Develop LLM-powered applications using modern language models, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and function/tool calling.

• Implement AI capabilities for product attribute enrichment, catalog classification, product understanding, content generation, and data normalization.

• Design context-building and retrieval mechanisms that provide agents with relevant product and business information.

• Evaluate model outputs for accuracy, consistency, groundedness, and business relevance.

• Optimize model selection, inference latency, token consumption, and operational costs.

**3. Knowledge Graphs & Commerce Intelligence**

• Design and implement knowledge graph-based representations of products, brands, categories, attributes, relationships, and commerce entities.

• Develop graph-based retrieval and reasoning capabilities to provide context to AI agents.

• Work with graph databases such as Neo4j and query languages such as Cypher.

• Integrate knowledge graphs with vector search, structured databases, and LLM-based applications.

• Build mechanisms to resolve entities, discover relationships, identify inconsistencies, and improve product intelligence.

• Contribute to the evolution of a reusable commerce knowledge layer that supports multiple agents and business workflows.

**4. Tools, APIs & Enterprise Integrations**

• Design reusable tools that agents can invoke through well-defined interfaces.

• Integrate internal services, external APIs, product information systems, search services, and data pipelines.

• Implement secure tool execution, input validation, permissions, structured responses, and failure handling.

• Explore and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) where it improves interoperability between agents and tools.

• Build standardized interfaces that allow multiple agents to access shared capabilities without duplicating business logic.

**5. System Design & Production Engineering**

• Design modular, scalable, and maintainable AI services with clear service boundaries.

• Build asynchronous and event-driven workflows using queues, workers, and APIs where appropriate.

• Apply system design principles covering concurrency, idempotency, state management, caching, persistence, and fault tolerance.

• Develop automated tests, evaluation pipelines, observability, and performance monitoring for AI systems.

• Deploy and operate production services using cloud infrastructure and modern development practices.

• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

• 3-6 years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or machine learning engineering.

• Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, modular, testable production code.

• Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs, including tool/function calling and structured outputs.

• Good understanding of agentic AI concepts, multi-step workflows, and agent orchestration.

• Strong fundamentals in system design, APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.

• Experience working with SQL databases and APIs; familiarity with search or vector retrieval systems.

• Understanding of data structures, algorithms, debugging, testing, and software design principles.

• Ability to reason about system reliability, AI quality, latency, cost, and architectural trade-offs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable technologies.

• Hands-on experience with Neo4j or another graph database, graph modeling, and graph queries.

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity resolution, semantic search, embeddings, RAG, and hybrid retrieval.

• Experience building reusable tools, function-calling interfaces, or MCP servers and clients.

• Familiarity with message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, Google Cloud Tasks, or AWS SQS.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS.

• Exposure to multimodal AI, computer vision, image generation, or product data intelligence.

• Experience at a strong product engineering organization or in a team with mature software engineering practices.

**What Success Looks Like**

• Build reliable, reusable agents that execute real commerce tasks rather than simply generate text.

• Develop an orchestration layer that coordinates tools, services, and agents with clear execution and failure-handling mechanisms.

• Enable agents to use the commerce knowledge graph for contextual retrieval and relationship-based reasoning.

• Improve the accuracy, consistency, and traceability of AI-generated product information.

• Deliver production-ready services with measurable quality, latency, reliability, and cost metrics.

• Contribute to a modular architecture that can support additional agents, tools, customers, and commerce use cases.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for an engineer who combines strong coding ability with practical GenAI experience and a system design mindset. The candidate should be comfortable moving between LLM applications, agent orchestration, tool development, knowledge graphs, and backend architecture.

We value engineers who understand the fundamentals behind the frameworks they use, can evaluate architectural trade-offs, and can take ownership of a problem from design through deployment.

Experience at a large technology company is a plus, but demonstrated engineering quality, problem-solving ability, and production experience matter more than company names.

**Interview Process**

**1 Coding and software engineering:**

Python, data structures, API design, and code quality.

**2 Agentic AI:**

Design an agent workflow that invokes tools, manages state, handles failures, and validates results.

**3 System design:**

Design a scalable orchestration service for commerce agents.

**4 Knowledge graphs:**

Model products, attributes, brands, and relationships; explain how agents retrieve and use graph context.

**5 Practical engineering:**

Implement or review a small agentic workflow with appropriate testing and error handling.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network — using protocols like 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI — and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time.
  
  
The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function — not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product.
  
  
You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features — authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding — primarily in Go.
* Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e.g., RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves.
* Build and extend internal test utility libraries — simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers — and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test.
* Drive root-cause analysis on test failures — distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it.
* Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented — shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end.
* Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers.
* Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue.
* Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework.
* Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews — identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field.
* 3–6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering — not just manual testing.
* Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis.
* Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols — 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong.
* Hands-on experience with REST API testing — designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code.
* Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) — writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability.
* Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication — test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS).
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) — knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior.
* Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios.
* Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) — validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

**Description**
Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?
  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.
  
  
The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.
  
  
You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.
  
  
The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
* Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
* Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
* Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
* Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
* Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
* Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
* Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.

As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage.

* Proficiency in C, C++, Objective-C, and Swift, with working knowledge of shell scripting (bash, zsh) and Python

**Individual Contributor**

You will be responsible for the technical configuration design and hands-on implementation of client journeys, policy rule sets, dynamic document models, risk rating logic, and security entitlements within Fenergo CLM. The position requires a deep technical understanding of Fenergo's declarative framework, data model, and workflow engine to translate complex institutional compliance requirements into scalable, maintainable platform configurations without writing custom application code.
  
  
Core Accountabilities
  
  

* Journey & Workflow Engine Configuration
* Own the technical design, configuration, and end-to-end testing of complex client lifecycle journeys across Corporate, Institutional, and Commercial Banking lines of business.
* Build and maintain workflows for Net-New Onboarding, Periodic KYC Refreshes, Event-Driven/Triggered Reviews, Material Change Ingestion, and Offboarding.
* Configure dynamic stage-gates, milestone triggers, complex decision splits, task orchestration, operational handoffs, and parallel processing branches.
* Implement SLA trackers, escalation paths, and automated fallback/exception handling mechanisms across jurisdictional booking locations.
* Policy, Risk & Regulatory Rules Setup
* Configure and maintain the Fenergo Policy Manager, Regulatory Rule Engine, and Entity Requirement Matrices across major regimes (e.g., FinCEN CDD, FATCA/CRS, EU 5MLD/6MLD, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS, HKMA, FCA).
* Set up dynamic Document Requirement Matrices, conditional document triggers, and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculation rules based on entity types, ownership thresholds, and control structures.
* Configure risk scoring criteria, automated SDD/CDD/EDD triggers, and integration points for screening triggers (Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media).
* Entitlements, Security & Data Visibility
* Design and configure granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), functional permission sets, user profiles, and multi-tier approval hierarchies.
* Configure strict data segregation and entitlement rules to enforce cross-border data privacy constraints and regional booking center restrictions.
* Implement Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes principle) controls, operational segregation of duties (SoD), and compliance sign-off stage-gates.
* Data Modeling, UI Forms & Business Rules
* Configure entity data models, complex multi-tier parent-subsidiary hierarchies, fund structures, authorized signers, and related parties in Fenergo.
* Build dynamic, conditional UI forms, custom data groups, dropdown hierarchies, and field-level validation rules.
* Configure data validation rules, format masking, and conditional visibility logic across various stages of the client journey.
* Technical Governance, Packaging & Releases
* Manage configuration asset version control, configuration deltas, XML/JSON deployment packages, and migration scripts across Dev, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.
* Perform pre-release impact assessments for Fenergo core upgrades, service packs, and policy changes to ensure backward compatibility and prevent configuration regressions.
* Troubleshoot advanced configuration defects, data structure inconsistencies, and journey bottlenecks in production and pre-production environments.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have Technical Expertise (Mandatory)
  
  

* Banking & Domain Background: 12 to 15 years of solid experience in Corporate/Investment Banking or Wholesale Financial Services, with deep exposure to KYC/AML, Client Onboarding, Due Diligence (CDD/EDD), and regulatory compliance operations.
* Senior Fenergo Hands-On Experience: Demonstrable, in-depth configuration experience on enterprise Fenergo CLM platforms (v8.x, v9.x, and/or SaaS/Cloud editions).
* Fenergo Journey & Workflow Mastery: Extensive track record building and debugging complex, multi-entity journeys, stage-gates, parallel branches, and exception routing rules.
* Policy Engine & Rules Configuration: Proven hands-on capability in configuring Fenergo Policy Manager, Entity Requirements Matrix, Dynamic Document Engine, and UBO threshold rules.
* Entitlement & Access Model Setup: Direct experience configuring complex user roles, permissions, data-level visibility rules, and cross-jurisdictional entitlement frameworks.
* Entity Data Modeling: Deep expertise in configuring Fenergo data dictionaries, custom attributes, entity relationship mapping, and dynamic UI forms.
* Environment & Package Management: Hands-on experience preparing configuration packages, managing environment-specific variables, and executing zero-downtime configuration deployments across multi-tier environments.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**

* Fenergo Certification: Fenergo Certified Product/Configuration Professional.
* API & Interface Payload Understanding: Strong functional familiarity with REST API / JSON / XML payload structures and data mapping dictionaries for integrating Fenergo with external screening engines (e.g., Fircosoft, World-Check), Core Banking, and Document Repositories.
* External Data Provider Integration: Experience configuring data enrichment lookups and connectors (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk/Orbis, Companies House, Refinitiv, GLEIF).
* Industry Compliance Certifications: ACAMS (CAMS) or ICA Diploma in AML/KYC.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in JIRA/Confluence within a Scrum/SAFe technical delivery model.

Scope & Non-Requirements
  
  

* Individual Contributor Scope: This is a dedicated technical and functional configuration role with no line management or people management responsibilities. The candidate will own technical deliverables, solution designs, and platform setup directly.
* No Software Coding Required: This role does not require software engineering or programming background (such as Java, C#, C++, Python, or web UI development). The focus is entirely on declarative platform configuration, rules engine authoring, data modeling, and workflow orchestration using Fenergo native configuration tools.

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native
**SaaS**
platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a
**multi-tenant**
control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. **SaaS**
scale.

**multi-tenant SaaS**
platform. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business.
  
  
This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters.

* Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance.
* Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions.

* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally.

* Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.
* Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.
* Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

* Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.

* Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.
* Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.
* Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

**The Kong DNA**

* Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.
* Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.
* Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD).
* Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. description:

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Developer with strong technical expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE/CRM), specifically in
**Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Project Operations**
and
**Field Service**
modules. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and implement scalable solutions, ensuring seamless integrations, optimized performance, and upgrade‑safe customizations. This role requires deep technical proficiency in Power Platform, CE extensions, and integration frameworks, with a focus on delivering business value through hands‑on development and automation.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technical Delivery & Development**

* Develop and customize Dynamics 365 CE applications (Sales, Customer Service, Project Operations, Field Service) using C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Power Platform tools.
* Build plug‑ins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom components to extend CE functionality.
* Ensure adherence to Microsoft best practices, extensibility framework, and upgrade‑safe customizations.
* Optimize CE solutions for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering**

* Design and implement integrations between CE and external systems using:

+ OData / Web APIs
+ REST / SOAP services
+ Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory

* Configure and manage Dual Write for seamless integration with Dynamics 365 F&O.
* Troubleshoot and optimize integration performance across Sales, Customer Service, Project Operations, Field Service

**Data Management, Security & Compliance**

* Support data migration strategies using Data Export Service, KingswaySoft, or DMF connectors.
* Configure security roles, privileges, and field‑level security to ensure compliance.
* Implement auditing, logging, and monitoring for CE applications.

**DevOps & Environment Management**

* Manage version control and code merges using GitHub repositories.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for CE solutions.
* Oversee build, release, and deployment activities across Dev/UAT/Prod environments.

**Automation & AI Solutions**

* Develop automation workflows using Power Automate and Copilot Studio.
* Leverage AI Builder for intelligent document processing, sentiment analysis, and predictive insights.
* Create reusable templates, frameworks, and accelerators for CE solution delivery.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with functional consultants, business analysts, and project teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Participate in workshops, demos, and technical discussions with Sales and Field Service stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance to peers and contribute to delivery excellence.

**What You Will Have**
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong hands‑on experience with Dynamics 365 CE modules (Sales, Customer Service, Project Operations, Field Service).
* Proficiency in plug‑in development, workflows, Power Automate, and custom UI components.
* Skilled in JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages).
* Knowledge of CE data model, entities, and security framework.

**Tools & Frameworks**

* Experience with Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Functions, API Management).
* Skilled in integration frameworks and ETL tools for CE data migration.
* Proficiency in GitHub, Azure DevOps pipelines, and environment management.

**Considerations for Top Candidates**

* Plug‑in Development Mastery – Advanced ability to design and implement custom plug‑ins in C# for complex business logic across Sales and Field Service.
* JavaScript/TypeScript Expertise – Skilled in customizing CE forms, ribbons, and UI components using modern scripting frameworks.
* Field Service Technical Depth – Strong knowledge of resource scheduling, work orders, service tasks, and mobile app customization for Field Service scenarios.
* Sales Process Customization – Ability to tailor lead, opportunity, and pipeline management processes with custom workflows and automation.
* Power Platform Integration – Hands‑on experience embedding Power Apps, Power BI dashboards, and Power Pages into CE solutions.
* Testing & Quality Assurance – Skilled in writing unit tests for plug‑ins, automated UI tests, and regression testing for CE customizations.
* Data Migration & ETL – Experience with tools like KingswaySoft, Scribe, or custom ETL pipelines for migrating CE data securely and efficiently.
* API & Web Resource Development – Ability to build and manage custom APIs, web resources, and secure authentication flows for CE integrations.
* Offline & Mobile Optimization – Expertise in configuring CE for mobile/offline scenarios, ensuring performance and usability for field engineers.
* Upgrade & Release Readiness – Ability to validate customizations against Microsoft CE updates, apply patches, and ensure upgrade‑safe delivery.
* Monitoring & Diagnostics – Skilled in using Application Insights, plug‑in trace logs, and telemetry to monitor CE performance and troubleshoot issues.
* Reusable Frameworks – Experience creating reusable libraries, templates, and accelerators to standardize CE development across projects.
* Test Automation Expertise – Extensive experience with modern testing frameworks and tools for Dynamics 365 CE applications. Preferred exposure to Leapwork, Azure App Testing, Playwright, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to ensure quality and reliability of Sales and Field Service customizations.
* Data Integration & Analytics Mastery – Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and other middleware solutions to design scalable integration pipelines, unify CE data, and deliver advanced reporting and analytics across all CE modules.

**Experience**

* 8–10+ years of ERP/CRM technical development experience, with 5+ years in Dynamics 365 CE.
* Proven track record in at least 4 full‑cycle CE implementations (Sales and/or Field Service).
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in cross‑functional teams.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* MB‑400: Microsoft Power Apps + Dynamics 365 Developer
* PL‑400: Microsoft Power Platform Developer
* PL‑600: Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect
* MB 210, MB 220, MB 230, & MB 240 Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant Associate

October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026

title: Lead AI/ML Engineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
The Principal AI/ML & Data Engineer will design, build, and operationalize enterprise-scale artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering capabilities for RxMax modernization. This role combines strong PBM domain understanding with hands-on engineering expertise to create trusted data products, intelligent applications, and reusable delivery patterns across pharmacy claims, rebates, pricing, disbursement, and operational workflows.
  
  
The engineer will help establish a sustainable internal capability by converting complex business rules and legacy knowledge into secure, scalable, well-governed solutions that improve delivery speed, quality, traceability, and maintainability.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* \\*AI/ML and Generative AI Engineering
* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy production-grade machine learning and generative AI solutions for PBM and RxMax use cases
* Build retrieval-augmented generation solutions, enterprise search experiences, AI agents, and repository-aware engineering assistants using approved models and platforms
* Create model and prompt evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, groundedness, safety, performance, reliability, and business value
* Operationalize models and AI services through repeatable MLOps practices, monitoring, versioning, testing, and controlled release processes
* Partner with product, engineering, operations, security, and compliance stakeholders to identify high-value use cases and translate them into measurable solutions
* \\*Data Engineering and Platform Development
* Architect and implement scalable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and serving pipelines across PBM data domains
* Build curated data products and reusable data services using Azure, Databricks, ADLS, Spark/PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and related technologies
* Engineer data pipelines that support batch, near-real-time, analytical, operational, and AI workloads while meeting performance and reliability requirements
* Implement data quality controls, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, observability, retention, and recoverability throughout the data lifecycle
* Optimize data layout, partitioning, query patterns, compute usage, and storage to improve performance and cost efficiency at large scale
* Develop secure access patterns for sensitive healthcare and PBM information, including appropriate masking, least-privilege access, and auditability
* \\*Modernization and Engineering Excellence
* Apply AI-assisted, repository-aware, and specification-driven engineering practices to accelerate modernization while preserving embedded RxMax business rules
* Create reusable frameworks for documentation, code analysis, data mapping, test generation, knowledge capture, and technical onboarding
* Build automated CI/CD pipelines with unit, integration, data-quality, security, and regression controls embedded early in the delivery lifecycle
* Collaborate with software engineering, quality engineering, SRE, DevSecOps, architecture, and data teams to deliver integrated end-to-end solutions
* Contribute to architecture decisions and proofs of concept by defining success criteria, implementing representative workloads, documenting evidence, and communicating tradeoffs
* Mentor engineers and establish practical standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns for AI and data engineering
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or a related discipline
* 5+ years of experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud data platforms or production data products
* Demonstrated experience building and operating production AI/ML solutions, not limited to experimentation or prototypes
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, orchestration, and cloud-native data services
* Experience with ML lifecycle tools and practices such as MLflow, feature engineering, model deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and retraining
* Experience designing APIs, reusable libraries, and integration patterns for data and AI-enabled applications
* Experience implementing automated testing, CI/CD, source control, infrastructure automation, and DevSecOps controls
* Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, distributed data processing, and software engineering practices
* Proven solid analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical leadership skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pharmacy benefit management, healthcare, pharmacy claims, rebates, formularies, drug pricing, payment allocation, billing, or disbursement processing
* Experience modernizing legacy applications, data platforms, or high-volume operational systems while preserving complex business logic
* Hands-on experience with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI or another enterprise LLM platform, embeddings, vector search, and RAG architectures
* Experience with Kafka or event streaming, change data capture, data federation, relational databases, and hybrid transactional/analytical architectures
* Experience with large-scale performance engineering, workload benchmarking, concurrency validation, and cost optimization
* Experience influencing architecture and technology decisions through prototypes, decision matrices, technical evidence, and executive-ready communication
* Working knowledge of healthcare privacy, security, regulatory, data-governance, and model-risk expectations.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Primary

+ AI/ML engineering
+ Generative AI and LLM applications
+ Python, SQL, Spark and PySpark
+ Databricks, ADLS and Delta Lake
+ MLOps and MLflow
+ Data architecture and pipelines
+ CI/CD and DevSecOps

* Secondary / Complementary

+ RAG, embeddings and vector search
+ Unity Catalog and data governance
+ Kafka and event streaming
+ Relational and NoSQL databases
+ APIs and microservices
+ Performance engineering
+ PBM and healthcare data domains

**Success Measures**

* Reliable, secure, and maintainable AI and data capabilities delivered into production
* Measurable reduction in manual effort, delivery cycle time, defects, and key-person dependency
* Improved data quality, traceability, documentation, test coverage, and platform observability
* Increased reuse of engineering patterns, data products, AI services, tests, and modernization assets
* Effective transfer of PBM and RxMax knowledge into internal engineering teams and durable technical artifacts

**Role Impact**
This position is critical to making RxMax an AI-accelerated modernization program rather than a collection of isolated technology experiments. The role will strengthen the trusted data foundation required for AI, accelerate modernization delivery, improve shift-left quality and security, preserve institutional knowledge, and reduce long-term dependency on external vendors.
  
  
*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Compute
description:
**About The Role And Team**
Batch Data Platform team is responsible for building Uber's Data Lake for the rest of the company. Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Staff Backend Engineer, you will lead the architecture and implementation of next-generation distributed systems that power the bedrock of Uber. This is a high-stakes, high-impact role where you’ll tackle some of the most complex infrastructure challenges in the industry: building sub-50ms latency systems that handle 1M+ requests per second, and designing resilient platforms that power tens of billions of dollars in global marketplace transactions across 70+ countries.
  
  
The team is proud to be a part of the open source community in innovating and shaping such exciting technologies as we move forward. Uber, as a business, is also growing rapidly, and Data at Uber is at the heart of almost all products e.g. Pricing predictions, Uber Pool route optimizations, Uber Eats restaurant recommendations, fraud detection, storage and processing of data collected from Autonomous vehicles etc.
  
  
By solving these business problems you will not only be helping Uber but also have a front row seat to build and innovate the future Big Data resource manager systems such as YARN and Kubernetes and contribute them back to open source. This is an exciting time to be part of the Data team at Uber. Sr Staff lead in this team will be a global lead for batch compute team including YARN and batch Kubernetes. Be sure to check out our engineering blog to learn more about the team
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design systems architecture and deliver software and tools to advance the reliability of infrastructure including availability, performance, efficiency and scaling.
* Provide technical leadership, influence and partner with fellow engineers to architect, design and build infrastructure that can stand the test of scale and availability, while reducing operational overhead.
* Drive efficiencies in systems and processes through automation: capacity planning, configuration management, performance tuning, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Collaborate with platform, product and security engineering teams, and enable successful use of infrastructure and foundational services, and manage upstream and downstream dependencies

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of professional experience in backend development and building world-class distributed systems in large-scale production environments.
* Proven ability to solve strategically important problems by leading organization-wide development and adoption of key frameworks and coding best practices.
* Experience foreseeing architectural problems or opportunities a year in advance and working with leadership to address them before they impact the business.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale engineering projects through all lifecycle stages, from inception and requirement gathering to global productionization.
* Expertise in defining standards for testing, monitoring, and alerting systems, while overseeing the execution of complex incident management at an organisational level.
* Proven experience in identifying architectural gaps and creating org-wide frameworks that improve developer velocity and reduce systemic technical debt.
* Demonstrated leadership in building strategic relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to rally an organization around a technical vision.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with big data resource manager systems - YARN, Kubernetes, Containers, etc preferred.
* Experience building hardened developer tools, SDKs, and abstractions (e.g., streaming data with Flink/Kafka) used by hundreds of engineers.
* Proficiency in cloud-native infrastructure (GCP) and containerization (Kubernetes) at a massive global scale.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
